messages:
ella_sales: Hey team — Connex wants a short POC to validate SSO (Okta) + SCIM group sync + RBAC mappings. They also asked about Dedicated pricing and domain ownership verification. They proposed Thu 9am PT.

raj_se: I can run this POC. Quick checks: 1) Are they using IdP-initiated SAML or SP-initiated? 2) Any requirement for automated cert rollover? 3) Expected scale (users/groups) for the test?

connex_okta_admin: Hi! We'll do SP-initiated. ~1.2k users, ~450 groups initially. Auto cert rotation preferred. Need SCIM delta under ~2m for our provisioning flows.

maria_sec: Security prelims: Hosted supports TLS + AES-256 at rest, can offer BYOK for Hosted via KMS integration (customers provide keys). For Dedicated/Private, HSM-backed KMS is supported. We need to vet their vendor questionnaire before enabling BYOK. Also capture retention requirements and deletion SLA.

izzy_prod: Product details: SCIM supports incremental sync with cursor paging — good for >1k groups. Default SCIM throttle: 5rps for Hosted, configurable on Dedicated. Group->role mapping is configurable; we support multiple group memberships mapping to a single role and role precedence rules. Domain verification: we support DNS TXT and email ownership flows.

raj_se: Draft POC runbook (short):
- Exchange SAML metadata + ACS and single logout endpoints
- Provision a SCIM token + endpoint on our side, limit to test org
- Provide role mapping file and verify group membership mapping
- Run initial full sync (sample 200 users), then delta tests and certificate rotation
- Validate audit logs and SCIM delta latency under load

Minimal example mapping I'll send:
```
{ 
  "groups_to_roles": {
    "Connex Engineers": "platform-dev",
    "Connex Admins": "org-admin"
  },
  "conflict_resolution": "highest_privilege"
}
```

jamie_legal: Legal items: ask for their legal contact and DPA requirements (EU data residency flagged). I'll prepare DPA + Data Processing Addendum + SOC2 Type II report. Need to know if they require specific contractual SLAs for deletion or breach notifications.

ella_sales: Pricing question from them: "If we convert to Dedicated for compliance (EU region), what is approximate monthly delta for 100M tokens/month?"

izzy_prod: Ballpark (very rough): Hosted consumption ~ $0.0008/token -> ~$80k/mo at 100M. Dedicated has infra commit and operational premium — expect +$25-45k/mo depending on replication and DR. We'll route to finance for exact quote. For POC we can allocate a reserved slot for 10 business days.

maria_sec: Operational note: For SCIM at that scale enable cursor paging and backoff strategy. Confirm Okta rate limits; advise batching group updates. Also clarify their cert rotation cadence — if it's <7 days we may need automated rekey flow.

raj_se: Action items: I'll assemble the runbook and post to #eng-sre and share the invite. Maria — please send the questionnaire and any BYOK checklist. Jamie — send DPA + SOC2. Ella — confirm Thu 9am PT with Connex and capture their Okta admin + legal contact.

deploy-bot: FYI: infra maintenance Thursday 08:30 PT — minor router updates, no expected impact.

connex_okta_admin: Thu 9am PT works. I'll send SP metadata and a test Okta account. Also attaching our internal provisioning doc (will DM).

ella_sales: Great — locking Thu 9am PT. Raj, please add rollback steps (fallback to Hosted model variant) and post runbook. Everyone please try to send docs before EOD Wed. :rocket:
